title: api-gateway: streaming proxy buffer, routing payload limits, and OpenAI-compat tool-call tweaks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: We observed intermittent stream stalls and unexpected client disconnects under high-concurrency proxying of streaming responses (especially when tool/function calls and structured OpenAI-compat delta messages are mixed). This PR does three related things in a conservative, feature-flag-gated way: 1) Increase and make configurable the per-connection streaming proxy buffer (default 1MB -> reduces buffer thrashing for large delta bursts). 2) Add explicit per-route payload size limits and route-priority semantics so large non-streaming requests do not starve streaming paths. 3) Tighten OpenAI-compat deltas and tool/function call chunking: normalize chunk boundaries, preserve JSON document framing for structured output, and ensure the adapter honors partial tool call payloads without aggregating multi-megabyte buffers. Implementation notes, tests, and docs are included. Checklist: - [x] Add new buffer config and env var + docs - [x] Implement per-route payload limit and routing priority - [x] Update OpenAI adapter to emit delta frames consistently and respect chunked tool outputs - [x] Add integration tests reproducing previous stall - [x] Add unit tests for routing priority and header sanitization - [x] Docs and release notes Changes are behind the feature flag `gate.streaming_buffer_v2`. Rollout plan: enable in staging for 48h, run canary traffic, then enable for 10% production, monitor stream success rate and tail latency. Related: SUP-1198 (support ticket reporting production stream stalls), ENG-4721 (routing design update).
